//: bfdb --instances <this file>. One entry per DCS server instance on this machine.
//default: Which instance answers a request that carries no ?instance=. Defaults to the first entry.

instances.//: Stable, URL-safe key. Rounds in the Sled DB are tagged with it -- never change it once a campaign has run.
instances.label: Vector Strike #1
instances.//base: netidx_base from THIS instance's engine CFG. Two instances must never share one.
instances.//sortie: Leave null to auto-detect from the stats stream. Set only if RPCs time out (see --sortie).
instances.//export_port: UDP port this instance's Scripts/Export.lua sends to. Must be unique per instance.
instances.//srs_url: This instance's SRS: an http(s) URL to proxy, or the local CLIENT_EXPORT_FILE_PATH json.
instances.//gci_config: This instance's live-GCI config (its own SRS port, freqs and callsigns).
instances.//dcs_server_name: The DCSServerBot server name. Lets a caller address this instance as ?server=<name>.
instances.dcs_server_name: [VS] Vector Strike - Vector Strike | Dynamic Campaign PVP Modern

instances.label: Vector Strike #2
instances.//public: false = a test/staging server: hidden from the selector for non-admins, and its rounds are excluded from the all-time leaderboard and pilot profiles. Defaults to true.
